sql_asli_1baris: WITH waktu AS ( SELECT mpl.id_pemeriksaan, MIN(mpl.created_at) FILTER (WHERE mpl.urutan_step = 2) AS t2, MIN(mpl.created_at) FILTER (WHERE mpl.urutan_step = 3) AS t3 FROM public.mv_pemeriksaan_log AS mpl GROUP BY mpl.id_pemeriksaan ), kerja AS ( SELECT w.id_pemeriksaan, w.t2, w.t3, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM generate_series(w.t2::date, w.t3::date - 1, '1 day') AS d(hari) WHERE EXTRACT(DOW FROM hari) BETWEEN 1 AND 5 -- Senin–Jumat ) AS workdays_between FROM waktu w WHERE w.t2 IS NOT NULL AND w.t3 IS NOT NULL AND w.t3::date > w.t2::date ) SELECT k.id_pemeriksaan, mp.nama_upt, mp.nama_sarana, k.t2 AS t2_timestamp, k.t3 AS t3_timestamp, k.workdays_between FROM kerja k JOIN public.mv_pemeriksaan mp ON mp.id = k.id_pemeriksaan WHERE k.workdays_between > 30 ORDER BY k.id_pemeriksaan;

sql_asli_1baris: WITH waktu AS ( SELECT mpl.id_pemeriksaan, MIN(mpl.created_at) FILTER (WHERE mpl.urutan_step = 3) AS t3, MIN(mpl.created_at) FILTER (WHERE mpl.urutan_step = 4) AS t4 FROM public.mv_pemeriksaan_log AS mpl GROUP BY mpl.id_pemeriksaan ), kerja AS ( SELECT w.id_pemeriksaan, w.t3, w.t4, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM generate_series(w.t3::date, w.t4::date - 1, '1 day') AS d(hari) WHERE EXTRACT(DOW FROM hari) BETWEEN 1 AND 5 -- Senin–Jumat ) AS workdays_between FROM waktu w WHERE w.t3 IS NOT NULL AND w.t4 IS NOT NULL AND w.t4::date > w.t3::date ) SELECT k.id_pemeriksaan, mp.nama_upt, mp.nama_sarana, k.t3 AS tanggal_ka_balai, k.t4 AS tanggal_pusat, k.workdays_between FROM kerja k JOIN public.mv_pemeriksaan mp ON mp.id = k.id_pemeriksaan WHERE k.workdays_between > 30 ORDER BY k.id_pemeriksaan;

sql_asli_1baris: WITH data_grading AS ( SELECT mp.grade, mp.kesimpulan, CASE WHEN UPPER(mp.grade) = 'A' AND UPPER(mp.kesimpulan) = 'MK' THEN 1 WHEN UPPER(mp.grade) IN ('B', 'C') AND UPPER(mp.kesimpulan) = 'TMK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS tepat FROM mv_pemeriksaan mp WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mp.tanggal_mulai) = 2025 AND mp.grade IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(mp.nama_upt) LIKE '%bogor%' ) SELECT grade, COUNT(*) AS total_pemeriksaan, SUM(tepat) AS jumlah_tepat, COUNT(*) - SUM(tepat) AS jumlah_tidak_tepat, ROUND((SUM(tepat)::decimal / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100, 2) AS persentase_ketepatan FROM data_grading GROUP BY grade ORDER BY grade;
sql_dipakai_1baris: WITH data_grading AS ( SELECT mp.grade, mp.kesimpulan, CASE WHEN UPPER(mp.grade) = 'A' AND UPPER(mp.kesimpulan) = 'MK' THEN 1 WHEN UPPER(mp.grade) IN ('B', 'C') AND UPPER(mp.kesimpulan) = 'TMK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS tepat FROM mv_pemeriksaan mp WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mp.tanggal_mulai) = 2025 AND mp.grade IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(mp.nama_upt) LIKE '%bogor%' ) SELECT grade, COUNT(*) AS total_pemeriksaan, SUM(tepat) AS jumlah_tepat, COUNT(*) - SUM(tepat) AS jumlah_tidak_tepat, ROUND((SUM(tepat)::decimal / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100, 2) AS persentase_ketepatan FROM data_grading GROUP BY grade ORDER BY grade;

sql_asli_1baris: WITH latest_target_year AS ( SELECT MAX(tb.tahun) AS tahun_terbaru FROM target_balai tb ), laporan_dikirim AS ( SELECT mp.nama_upt, mp.komoditi, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mp.tanggal_selesai) AS tahun, COUNT(*) AS jumlah_laporan FROM mv_pemeriksaan mp WHERE mp.tanggal_selesai IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mp.tanggal_selesai) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) and lower(mp.sarana) = 'distribusi' GROUP BY mp.nama_upt, mp.komoditi, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mp.tanggal_selesai) ) SELECT ld.nama_upt, ld.komoditi, ld.tahun AS tahun_laporan, tb.tahun AS tahun_target, ld.jumlah_laporan, tb.target_sarana_distribusi, ROUND( (ld.jumlah_laporan::decimal / NULLIF(tb.target_sarana_distribusi, 0)) * 100, 2 ) AS capaian_persen FROM laporan_dikirim ld CROSS JOIN latest_target_year lty LEFT JOIN target_balai tb ON LOWER(TRIM(tb.nama_balai)) = LOWER(TRIM(ld.nama_upt)) AND LOWER(TRIM(tb.komoditi)) = LOWER(TRIM(ld.komoditi)) AND tb.tahun = lty.tahun_terbaru ORDER BY ld.nama_upt, ld.komoditi;
sql_dipakai_1baris: WITH latest_target_year AS ( SELECT MAX(tb.tahun) AS tahun_terbaru FROM target_balai tb ), laporan_dikirim AS ( SELECT mp.nama_upt, mp.komoditi, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mp.tanggal_selesai) AS tahun, COUNT(*) AS jumlah_laporan FROM mv_pemeriksaan mp WHERE mp.tanggal_selesai IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mp.tanggal_selesai) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) and lower(mp.sarana) = 'distribusi' GROUP BY mp.nama_upt, mp.komoditi, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mp.tanggal_selesai) ) SELECT ld.nama_upt, ld.komoditi, ld.tahun AS tahun_laporan, tb.tahun AS tahun_target, ld.jumlah_laporan, tb.target_sarana_distribusi, ROUND( (ld.jumlah_laporan::decimal / NULLIF(tb.target_sarana_distribusi, 0)) * 100, 2 ) AS capaian_persen FROM laporan_dikirim ld CROSS JOIN latest_target_year lty LEFT JOIN target_balai tb ON LOWER(TRIM(tb.nama_balai)) = LOWER(TRIM(ld.nama_upt)) AND LOWER(TRIM(tb.komoditi)) = LOWER(TRIM(ld.komoditi)) AND tb.tahun = lty.tahun_terbaru ORDER BY ld.nama_upt, ld.komoditi;

pertanyaan: upt mana saja yang sering melaporkan hasil pemeriksaan lebih dari 30 hari kerja dari tanggal pemeriksaan hingga tanggal kirim ka upt?
pertanyaan_ner: upt mana saja yang sering melaporkan hasil pemeriksaan lebih dari 30 hari kerja dari tanggal pemeriksaan hingga tanggal kirim ka upt?
sql_asli_1baris: WITH waktu AS ( SELECT mpl.id_pemeriksaan, MIN(mpl.created_at) FILTER (WHERE mpl.urutan_step = 2) AS t2, MIN(mpl.created_at) FILTER (WHERE mpl.urutan_step = 3) AS t3 FROM public.mv_pemeriksaan_log AS mpl GROUP BY mpl.id_pemeriksaan ), kerja AS ( SELECT w.id_pemeriksaan, w.t2, w.t3, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM generate_series(w.t2::date, w.t3::date - 1, '1 day') AS d(hari) WHERE EXTRACT(DOW FROM hari) BETWEEN 1 AND 5 -- Senin–Jumat ) AS workdays_between FROM waktu w WHERE w.t2 IS NOT NULL AND w.t3 IS NOT NULL AND w.t3::date > w.t2::date ) SELECT k.id_pemeriksaan, mp.nama_upt, mp.nama_sarana, k.t2 AS t2_timestamp, k.t3 AS t3_timestamp, k.workdays_between FROM kerja k JOIN public.mv_pemeriksaan mp ON mp.id = k.id_pemeriksaan WHERE k.workdays_between > 30 ORDER BY k.id_pemeriksaan;
sql_dipakai_1baris: WITH waktu AS ( SELECT mpl.id_pemeriksaan, MIN(mpl.created_at) FILTER (WHERE mpl.urutan_step = 2) AS t2, MIN(mpl.created_at) FILTER (WHERE mpl.urutan_step = 3) AS t3 FROM public.mv_pemeriksaan_log AS mpl GROUP BY mpl.id_pemeriksaan ), kerja AS ( SELECT w.id_pemeriksaan, w.t2, w.t3, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM generate_series(w.t2::date, w.t3::date - 1, '1 day') AS d(hari) WHERE EXTRACT(DOW FROM hari) BETWEEN 1 AND 5 -- Senin–Jumat ) AS workdays_between FROM waktu w WHERE w.t2 IS NOT NULL AND w.t3 IS NOT NULL AND w.t3::date > w.t2::date ) SELECT k.id_pemeriksaan, mp.nama_upt, mp.nama_sarana, k.t2 AS t2_timestamp, k.t3 AS t3_timestamp, k.workdays_between FROM kerja k JOIN public.mv_pemeriksaan mp ON mp.id = k.id_pemeriksaan WHERE k.workdays_between > 30 ORDER BY k.id_pemeriksaan;
